source.name: Siegmund (Bernd Siegmund GmbH) – Siegmund & FC Bayern Basketball (sports sponsoring page)
source.quote: Siegmund is the main sponsor of FC Bayern's basketball team.
source.note: date precision: year; the page carries no publication date. The same page states the team played 'each time with the Siegmund logo on their chest' through the 2025 championship season, and EuroLeague's kit-launch article 'Bayern unveils its new jersey for the 2026-27 season' (12 June 2026, euroleaguebasketball.net) describes the club crest 'sitting cleanly above the Siegmund sponsor logo on the chest' of the 2026-27 home jersey; that page blocks scripts (HTTP 429), so it could not be cited directly.

summary: Siegmund (Bernd Siegmund GmbH, family-run welding-table maker) is the main and jersey sponsor on the chest of the 2026/27 home jersey, continuing a deal running since 2022/23. adidas is the kit maker (not listed as a sponsor, per repo convention) and no other placement on the 2026/27 kit (back, shorts, training wear) could be verified from an openable source, so the list is not complete.
